SKILL_ATHLETICS.description: Raw physical power applied to movement — climbing, swimming, jumping, and forcing barriers. Some locations are unreachable without it.

SKILL_DISCIPLINE.description: The capacity to endure pain, stun, exhaustion, and hunger — and to keep functioning anyway. Not the absence of suffering, but the refusal to let it decide.

SKILL_SURVIVAL.description: Staying alive in hostile environments through practical knowledge: foraging, shelter, first aid, and reading the land.

SKILL_MARTIAL_EXPERTISE.description: Advanced physical combat techniques — not hitting harder, but hitting smarter. Where raw Body determines force, Martial Expertise determines whether that force is applied with precision and timing.

SKILL_ACROBATICS.description: Precise movement through difficult space — vaulting, tumbling, balancing, landing without injury. Where Athletics is about power, Acrobatics is about control.

SKILL_STEALTH.description: Moving without being seen or heard. Timing footsteps to background noise, pressing into shadows, controlling breathing.

SKILL_PERCEPTION.description: Noticing what is out of place before knowing why. Perception is the skill that tells you something is wrong.

SKILL_SLEIGHT_OF_HAND.description: Fine motor control applied with intent: picking locks, disarming traps, palming objects. Where Perception notices, Sleight of Hand acts — quietly and without leaving obvious evidence.

SKILL_ARCANA.description: Understanding magic as a system — its rules, its history, its failures. Magic is a language, and this skill is literacy.

SKILL_TECHNOLOGY.description: Understanding machines and the principles behind them — from clockwork mechanisms to advanced computers and security networks.

SKILL_INVESTIGATION.description: Active, methodical searching for information — crime scenes, cross-referenced accounts. Where Perception notices that something is wrong, Investigation finds out why. It can also be used to uncover hidden information or inconsistencies in records.

SKILL_ALCHEMY.description: Understanding the chemical and biological properties of substances, and how to combine, refine, or extract them into new forms.

SKILL_PERSUASION.description: Changing minds through reasoned argument. Unlike Deception it works best when you are telling the truth. The most durable agreements are made through Persuasion.

SKILL_FAITH.description: Absolute conviction in something larger than the self. The mechanical effect is real regardless of whether the object of faith deserves it.

SKILL_HAGGLE.description: The art of negotiation, valuation, and trade. Understanding what something is worth, what the other party wants, and where the deal becomes unprofitable.

SKILL_AURA.description: The projection of presence, will, and dominance. Every creature can feel a sufficiently fierce aura — in the weight of a voice, the stillness before violence.
